headline.caveat: undisclosed participation in Nscale's $1.1B Series B (Sep 2025, led by Aker); NVIDIA also backed the later round at a $14.6B valuation (Mar 2026)

realized_to_date.caveat: NVIDIA's individual check sizes not disclosed

nature_md: NVIDIA participated in Nscale's $1.1B Series B (announced Sep 25, 2025) — the largest Series B in UK/European history — led by Aker ASA ($285M) with Blue Owl managed funds, Dell, Fidelity, G Squared, Nokia, Point72, Sandton, and T.Capital. Proceeds fund Nscale's European AI-infrastructure buildout including Stargate Norway/UK sites targeting ~100K NVIDIA GPUs at Narvik before 2027. NVIDIA participated again when Nscale raised at a $14.6B valuation (Mar 2026). Equity into a neocloud whose ~$20B+ of Microsoft contracts are fulfilled with ~200K NVIDIA GB300s.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Non-marketable equity investment on NVIDIA's balance sheet; another instance of equity seeding a large GPU buyer (see Nebius, CoreWeave, Nokia edges).
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Series B equity financing — no revenue; strengthens the balance sheet against which Nscale contracts GPU supply and data-center leases for the Microsoft deployments.
